detail.none: Choose a user to see their usage and actions.
detail.usageNote: Usage only: counts and dates. The ideas and answers in a workspace are not shown here.
detail.deleted: This account was deleted. It has no actions.

users.suspendBody: They are logged out now and can't log in until you reactivate them. Their workspaces, shares and assignments stay, and their name shows "(suspended)". They are not notified.
users.reactivateBody: They can log in again, and everything is as it was before the suspension.

detail.none: Choose a workspace to see its usage.
detail.usageNote: Usage only: counts and dates. The ideas and answers in a workspace are not shown here.

empty.heading: No invitations yet
empty.body: Invite someone by email. With a workspace and a role they join it; without one they get only their own workspace.

detail.none: Choose an invitation to resend or cancel it.

invitations.cancelBody: The link stops working. You can invite the same address again.

dialog.title: New invitation
dialog.workspaceHelp: Optional. Leave empty to give them only a personal workspace.
dialog.workspaceLoadFailed: Couldn't load all workspaces. Try again.
dialog.roleHelp: The role they get in the workspace.

templates.title: Templates
templates.draftExists: This template has a draft. Open it to keep editing; a template has one draft at a time.

edit.title: {{name}} v{{number}}

readOnly.heading: v{{number}} is published
readOnly.body: A published version can't be edited. To change it, start a new draft from this version.

edit.none: Choose a section, a question or a setting to edit.

delete.sectionBody_one: The section and its {{count}} question are deleted from this draft.
delete.sectionBody_other: The section and its {{count}} questions are deleted from this draft.
delete.questionBody: The question is deleted from this draft. Answers already given in earlier versions are kept.

section.heading: Section {{key}}
section.keyHelp: Capital letters, digits and _ only. Question IDs in the section carry it.
section.keyInvalid: Use capital letters, digits and _ (up to 40 characters)
section.title: Title

question.heading: Question {{key}}
question.keyHelp: Looks like {{start}}. It can't change once the version is published.
question.keyInvalid: Must look like {{start}}: capital letters, digits and _
question.title: Title
question.fauHelp: The answer gets an F/A/U label and counts in the validation's breakdown.
question.copyFromHelp: What a new plan draft copies into this item, one per line: a validation question ID, or IDEA.ONE_LINE_CONCEPT, IDEA.PROPOSED_SOLUTION, LIST.ASSUMPTIONS, LIST.RISKS.
question.switchBody: The choices, columns or numbers set for the current type are cleared. Answers already given are kept.
question.copyFromTooLong: Up to 50 sources, each up to 100 characters

options.metricKeysHelp: One per line: a key number, scenario:<name>, or a cost row key.

cost.heading: Cost rows
cost.help: The rows a new validation starts with in each cost table. A key is unique in the version and is what checks and plan items refer to.
cost.name: Row name
cost.keyInvalid: Use lower-case letters, digits and _, joined by dots (initial.permits)

checks.heading: Check thresholds
checks.help: What each check needs before it shows Done. The costs and break-even checks have no threshold.
checks.rangeInvalid: The minimum can't be above the maximum
checks.localPricePriced: Local price: competitors with a price
checks.localPriceLogs: Local price: research logs tagged to it
checks.permitsLogs: Permits: research logs tagged to it
checks.demandLogs: Demand signal: research logs tagged to it

execution.heading: Execution rows
execution.help: The milestones, launch items and KPIs a new plan draft starts with.
execution.title: Title

prompt.heading: AI prompt
prompt.help: The conversation prompt the export for AI puts under # Prompt. Leave it empty to leave that section out.
prompt.label: Prompt

preview.title: Preview
preview.executionNone: Shows an execution list. Choose which one in the options.

publish.title: Publish as v{{number}}

publish.removed_one: {{count}} question ID is not in this version
publish.removed_other: {{count}} question IDs are not in this version
